paper_title: First results from the Axion Dark-Matter Birefringent Cavity (ADBC) experiment
notes: First results from ADBC optical birefringent cavity axion DM search. Paper probes three mass windows: 40.9-43.3 neV (9.88-10.45 MHz), 49.3-50.6 neV (11.92-12.22 MHz), and 54.4-56.7 neV (13.12-13.69 MHz) over five datasets. Only the average 95% upper limit g_agamma <= 1.9e-8 GeV^-1 is quoted numerically in text; full frequency-dependent limit is in Fig. 3 but not tabulated. Emitted points are the band endpoints at the average sensitivity level (actual limit varies ~1e-9 to 1e-7 GeV^-1 within bands per Fig. 3 axis). Haloscope-type DM search assuming rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3.
